reader_question: What happens after someone applies for SNAP food benefits, and how long can each step take?
grade_line: Documented: the text of 7 CFR 273.2, as in force on November 9, 2026
title: Under the federal SNAP rule, a state has at most 30 days from an application to a decision, and at most seven days for a household with very little income or cash.
measure_line: Steps from a SNAP application to a decision, with the longest time the federal rule allows for each, 7 CFR 273.2 as in force November 9, 2026, United States; the times are the rule’s limits, and the chart measures no household’s wait
notes: SNAP, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, helps households buy food. States run it within these federal rules; a state may move faster, and some miss the limits.
The rule gives the household at least 10 days to send proof. It sets no day for the interview, which a state may hold by phone or, in some cases, waive.

The state still interviews a household on the expedited branch within the seven days. The state may postpone some proof to get benefits out; that proof comes due by the second or third month of benefits.

The rule gives expedited service to three kinds of household: one with under $150 in monthly gross income and no more than $100 in cash and other liquid resources; a destitute migrant or seasonal farmworker household with no more than $100 in such resources; and one whose monthly gross income and liquid resources together fall short of its monthly rent or mortgage and utilities. The chart calls them households with very little income or cash.
alt: Four steps in order, each a box with who acts and the time the rule allows: the household files an application, taken the same day; an interview; the household sends proof, with at least 10 days to do it; and the state’s decision, within 30 days of filing. A branch after filing leads to expedited service, an interview and benefits within 7 days, for a household with very little income or cash, with postponed proof due later.
chart_notes: The main path is in the text’s ink, and the expedited branch is gray.

phone_note: On a phone the steps read down the page, and the expedited branch follows the last step, its line running down the right edge from the first step.

limits.2: no day set in the rule
limits.3: at least 10 days to send it
limits.4: within 30 days of filing, the rule’s limit
limits.5: interview and benefits within 7 days of filing, the rule’s limit
